text: The 2022 loss of approximately 0.6 hectares of native forest on the 17.6-hectare rural property could have been caused by various factors. The evidence indicates that the loss was mapped by Hansen/UMD, but it does not specify the exact cause. Possible reasons for the tree-cover loss include harvesting, fire, storms, or clearing. The evidence does not establish whether the change was legal, authorized, or illegal, nor does it identify who was responsible. Further investigation would be needed to determine the specific cause of the forest loss.
